metric_definitions.MAE: Mean Absolute Error: average absolute prediction error in original target units.
metric_definitions.RMSE: Root Mean Squared Error: square-root mean squared prediction error; larger errors receive more weight.
metric_definitions.MAPE_percent: Mean Absolute Percentage Error, reported in percent for positive targets.
metric_definitions.R2: Coefficient of determination; 1 is perfect fit and values below 0 can occur when the model is worse than the evaluated mean baseline.
metric_definitions.directional_accuracy: Supplementary stock metric: fraction of test days for which predicted and actual price-change directions match.
